description: Find sales contacts and companies, manage lead lists, and look up outreach activity.

amplemarket_new_account_trigger.description: Runs for each new account in Amplemarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, website, linkedin_url, owner_email, last_contacted_at, last_engaged_at

amplemarket_new_call_trigger.description: Runs for each new call in Amplemarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, from, to, duration, transcription, transcript, recording_url, answered, human, external, direction, start_date, disposition_id, disposition_name, task_id, user_id, user_email, contact.id, contact.name, contact.email

amplemarket_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in Amplemarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, first_name, last_name, email, linkedin_url, title, location, time_zone, company_name, company_domain, owner, created_at, last_contacted_at, crm.provider, crm.contact_name, crm.contact_url, crm.owner, crm.type, crm.id, phone_numbers

amplemarket_new_lead_list_trigger.description: Runs for each new lead list in Amplemarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, status, url, shared, visible, owner, created_at, updated_at, type

amplemarket_new_sequence_trigger.description: Runs for each new sequence in Amplemarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, status, priority, url, tags, dynamic_fields_used, created_by_user_id, created_by_user_email, created_at, updated_at

amplemarket_new_task_trigger.description: Runs for each new task in Amplemarket. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, automatic, type, status, notes, due_on, finished_on, sequence_key, sequence_name, user_id, user_email, contact.id, contact.name, contact.email
